avatar.description: An image with a fallback for representing a person, agent, or account, with optional status and group composition.
avatar.userDetails: Avatar with user details and badge
avatar.accessibilityBody: Give meaningful profile images an alt text that identifies the person; use an empty alt when the nearby text already provides the same name. Initials remain readable fallback content. When a badge communicates presence or another status, include a visually hidden label or expose the same status in adjacent text. Label group counts so screen readers hear what the number represents.
avatar.sizeProp: Sets the root, fallback text, badge, and group-count dimensions.
avatar.classNameProp: Adds classes to the component while preserving its default styling.
avatar.renderProp: Replaces the root element through Base UI render composition.
avatar.srcProp: Image source passed to the underlying image element.
avatar.altProp: Accessible alternative text for the image.
avatar.loadingStatusProp: Runs when the image loading state changes.
avatar.delayProp: Waits this many milliseconds before showing the fallback.
avatar.compositionClassNameProp: Adds classes and native element props to the composition helper.
avatar.detailsAvatarProp: Avatar content rendered before the user details.
avatar.detailsDescriptionProp: Optional secondary detail, such as a role or email address.
avatar.detailsBadgeProp: Optional content beside the name, typically a Badge.
avatar.detailsSizeProp: Controls the spacing, typography, and nested avatar size.
